Definition: from G1722 and G5195; to insult:--do despite unto.
BiblicalUsage: To insult, to do despite unto — Hebrews asks what punishment belongs to the one who has trodden under foot the Son of God and done despite unto the Spirit of grace in Hebrews 10:29.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe insulting the Spirit of grace is the last step of a long road away from God, and the warning is written so I will never take the first step.
